name: anti-scam-agent
description: An anti-fraud intelligence agent driven by financial black & grey industry intelligence, covering telecom network fraud, professional debt mules, loan packaging, anti-collection and other common financial black & grey industries. It can analyze, take action and raise alerts, helping institutions achieve more scientific, efficient and sustainable confrontation against black & grey industries.
